Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of licensing to conduct a review of the need for regulation of process servers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a sunrise review of the need for regulation ofprocess servers; creating a new section; and providing an expirationdate.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of licensing shallconduct a review of the need for regulation of persons who serve legalprocess using the public interest criteria set forth in RCW 18.118.010.In conducting the review, the department of licensing shall: (a) Consult with representatives of process servers, courts,attorneys, and law enforcement, and any entity or individual that mayassist in identifying areas of concern regarding professionalism andqualifications of process servers; (b) Examine the regulation of process servers in other states; and (c) Conduct one or more public hearings to allow for industry andgeneral public testimony. (2) By November 1, 2014, the department of licensing shall submitrecommendations to the appropriate committees of the legislatureregarding: (a) The need for regulation of process servers; and p. 1 HB 2391 (b) If some form of regulation is recommended, the minimumqualifications and oversight required to meet the regulatory standard. (3) This section expires July 1, 2015.
